arxiv.title: Distributionally-Robust Policy Learning with Observational Data
arxiv.abstract: Policy learning from observational data is fundamental to applications ranging from personalized medicine to welfare-program targeting, but standard approaches optimize empirical performance and may fail when the deployment distribution differs from the training distribution. We study \emph{distributionally-robust policy learning}: given observational data, we seek a policy $π\in Π$ that maximizes the worst-case policy value over an $f$-divergence ball of radius $ρ$ around the data-generating distribution. We propose an estimator built on cross-fitted doubly-robust scores for the conditional treatment effect, paired with a DRO solver that handles \texttt{KL}, $χ^2$, and \texttt{CVaR} ambiguity sets. We establish two convergence guarantees. First, the estimated policy attains the standard $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$ rate on its DRO regret, and inherits the doubly-robust property -- the rate continues to hold whenever either the outcome model or the propensity model is consistently estimated, even at slow nonparametric rates. We then propose a sample-splitting bias-correction algorithm derived from the Lagrangian dual, and show that under a Tsybakov-style margin condition on the treatment-effect, the estimator attains a fast rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})$ , interpolating between $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/n)$ as the margin parameter $α$ ranges over $[0,\infty)$. To our knowledge, this is the first work to incorporate a margin condition into the analysis of distributionally-robust policy learning, and the first to obtain fast rates in this setting. Empirically, on synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments calibrated to a welfare-to-work program, distributional robustness yields meaningful improvements over empirical welfare maximization when training and test distributions differ.

arxiv.titleZh: 基于观测数据的分布鲁棒策略学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 观测数据下的策略学习常用经验最优准则，当部署分布偏离训练分布时性能会显著退化。为此，该工作把策略学习表述为在数据生成分布周围的f散度球内最大化最坏情况策略价值的分布鲁棒问题，并基于交叉拟合的双稳健条件处理效应得分构造估计量，配合可处理KL、χ²与CVaR不确定集的DRO求解器。理论上有两点保证：DRO遗憾达到Õ(n^{-1/2})并继承双稳健性；进一步在Tsybakov型边际条件下经拉格朗日对偶的样本分裂偏差校正获得Õ(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})快速率。在针对福利就业项目校准的半合成实验中，训练与测试分布不一致时分布鲁棒性带来明显收益。

arxiv.title: Divergence based Ranked Preference Alignment for LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Alignment of large language models typically relies on pairwise preference feedback, though ranked feedback can capture more comprehensive information across multiple responses within a single annotation. However, ranked-preference alignment is underexplored in practice compared to simpler pairwise approaches, potentially resulting in suboptimal behavior. Concurrently, recent research has conceptualized large language model alignment objectives as divergence estimators between aligned (preferred) and unaligned (less-preferred) response distributions, resulting in a family of objectives with an interpretable theoretical foundation and strong empirical performance. This work unifies these perspectives by introducing $f$-RPO, a $f$-divergence objective for ranked preference optimization that extends divergence-based alignment to ranked feedback and recovers pairwise preference alignment as a special case. Our theoretical analysis establishes rank-order consistency, showing that $f$-RPO preserves the underlying preference ordering at convergence. Empirical results indicate that total-variation and reverse-KL variants of the proposed objective consistently outperform ranked-alignment baselines in both ranking and generation quality across Qwen, Llama, & Gemma models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于散度的 LLM 排序偏好对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: 成对偏好反馈信息量有限，而排序偏好对齐的实践研究仍显不足。该工作把基于散度的对齐目标从成对偏好推广到排序反馈，提出f-RPO:用f-散度统一刻画对齐(偏好)与未对齐(非偏好)响应分布之间的差异，成对偏好对齐成为其特例。理论分析给出排序一致性(rank-order consistency)，即收敛时保持底层偏好序。在0.5B–8B的Qwen、Llama、Gemma上，全变差与反向KL两个变体在排序与生成质量上均稳定优于排序对齐基线。

arxiv.title: Assertion and Belief: Moore's Paradox in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Moore's paradox \citep{moore1942} concerns sentences such as ``It is raining, but I don't believe that it is,'' which may well be true yet cannot be sensibly asserted. The absurdity lies not in the content but in the act, since to assert is to vouch for one's own belief. This makes the paradox a test of whether language models take the speech act into account when computing meaning. We present the first test of Moore's paradox in LLMs, evaluating 12 models on a curated set of Moorean sentences in varied contexts. We find that models largely recognize the infelicity of Moorean sentences, and that the judgement is not tied to a memorized form and tracks the speech act. Using the Rational Speech Act framework (RSA; \citealt{goodmanfrank2016}), we then test whether these judgements arise from a listener reasoning about a speaker. We find the models' own listeners do not reason about their own speakers, and their reasoning traces suggest that they instead recall knowledge about the paradox and apply rules therein. The models thus appear to have learned the paradox as a fact about sentences, not as a requirement on speakers.
arxiv.titleZh: 断言与信念：语言模型中的摩尔悖论
arxiv.summaryZh: 摩尔悖论指「正在下雨，但我不相信在下雨」这类句子可以为真却无法被合理断言，其荒谬来自言语行为而非内容，因而可用于检验语言模型在计算意义时是否考虑言语行为。首次在12个模型上、以多样化语境下的摩尔句进行测试，发现模型大多能识别这类句子的不适切性，且判断不依赖记忆的句面形式，而随言语行为变化。进一步用Rational Speech Act框架检验该判断是否源于听者对说话者的推理，结果显示模型的听者并不推理说话者，其推理轨迹更像是在回忆关于悖论的既有知识并套用规则。这表明模型把摩尔悖论学成了关于句子的事实，而非对说话者的要求。
arxiv.reason: LLM语用探测较有趣，但偏语言学，与后训练/Agent主线仅擦边

arxiv.title: CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series arise in many real-world domains such as healthcare, climate science, and large-scale monitoring systems. Characterized by asynchronous observations and heterogeneity across variables, such time series pose significant challenges for forecasting. In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables. CVTA uses Variable-Conditioned Embeddings to project heterogeneous variables into variable-specific latent spaces, and applies temporal attention to capture cross-variable dependencies from this state. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CVTA can be integrated as an auxiliary module into existing state-of-the-art prediction models through a dynamic meta-decision model. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks show that CVTA achieves strong short-term predictive accuracy, supports efficient online inference, improves existing prediction models when used as an auxiliary module, and learns attention patterns that align well with domain knowledge.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Main Track
arxiv.titleZh: CVTA：面向多变量不规则时间序列预测的跨变量时间注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对异步采样、变量异质的多变量不规则时间序列预测难题，提出连续时间短期预测框架CVTA：以紧凑可解释的状态汇总各变量近期时序动态，用变量条件嵌入把异质变量投影到变量专属隐空间，并在该状态上施加时间注意力捕捉跨变量依赖，还可经动态元决策模型作为辅助模块接入现有预测模型。多个真实基准实验显示其短期预测精度较强、支持高效在线推理，作为辅助模块能提升现有模型，且学到的注意力模式与领域知识吻合。适用于医疗、气候与大规模监控等不规则采样场景。
arxiv.reason: 不规则时序预测与LLM主线无直接交集，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate's input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.
arxiv.comment: 32 pages
arxiv.titleZh: 有限交互透镜：面向视觉语言模型的结构化精度共享
arxiv.summaryZh: 视觉干预的联合效应与单独效应差异往往极小，容易被舍入误差淹没。有限交互透镜（FIL）是一种混合精度评估方法：在每个选定的线性投影处，把候选输入分解为本征状态、两个单干预分量与全维混合残差，以更高精度投影单干预分量并复用到联合候选中，同时保留全部混合残差与非线性轨迹，并给出局部抵消恒等式与经平滑非线性的误差传播条件界。在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的一个MLP中，FIL将最终交互MSE在16个合成族上降低94.4%，在两项COCO四图研究中分别降低99.85%与99.35%。该工作说明固定名义精度预算下可提升交互保真度，适用于需要精细干预效应的VLM机制分析。
arxiv.reason: VLM干预分析中的混合精度数值方法，选题偏窄且增量

arxiv.title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
arxiv.abstract: While retrieval-augmented language models increasingly serve as literature assistants in the physical sciences, existing benchmarks evaluate them primarily on qualitative text overlap or through model-based scoring rather than against verified experimental ground truth. In experimental materials disciplines such as perovskite photovoltaics, however, the most critical inquiries are inherently quantitative and aggregate measurements across dozens or hundreds of papers. Here, we present a quantitative question-answering benchmark where all 755 ground-truth answers are computed directly from 45,441 measured device records (40,889 human-curated records through 2021 and 4,552 records extracted from 2022-2026 literature). Benchmarking six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU, standard passage retrieval tops out at 16-23% accuracy (compared to 1.6-6.5% zero-shot). In contrast, equipping the language model with read-only SQL execution over the structured device table elevates accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature -- a 33.01.8 percentage-point advantage over hybrid text retrieval. Aggregate queries spanning extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts prove virtually unsolvable via text retrieval alone, demonstrating that systematic table extraction is an operational prerequisite for literature-scale quantitative inquiry.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 面向钙钛矿光伏的结构化检索增强生成基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有科学文献RAG基准多以文本重叠或模型打分评判，缺少可验证的实验真值，而材料领域的关键问题往往需要跨数十至数百篇论文聚合定量测量。该工作以45,441条器件测量记录（含2021年前人工整理记录与2022–2026年文献抽取记录）计算出755个定量问答真值，在25,662篇论文的158,274个段落上评测六种检索架构，并对比在单张24GB GPU上运行的开放14B模型接入只读SQL执行接口的效果。结果显示纯段落检索准确率仅16–23%（零样本1.6–6.5%），而SQL执行在历史与前瞻文献上分别达51.5%与50.8%，较混合文本检索高出33.0±1.8个百分点。这表明系统化表格抽取是文献规模定量问答的前提条件，对科学Agent的检索与工具调用设计有参考价值。
arxiv.reason: RAG与评测方法学沾边，但属材料领域垂直基准，分量有限

arxiv.title: Representations in Motion: Layer-wise Rotation and Trajectory Divergence in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Recent work suggests that activation dynamics--how representations change during inference--might be more revealing about language model behavior than static readouts from individual layers. In this work, we investigate the layer-wise evolution of representations of factuality, using true and false statements when the model is prompted to either lie or to be honest. We report a geometric phenomenon in which the factuality directions extracted from the lying and honest conditions appear to rotate away from each other across layers. We find that such layer-wise rotation also occurs in a task that requires the model to take different visual perspectives in the 3D world, suggesting that the rotation phenomenon might be indicative of manipulating conceptual spaces in general, rather than unique to factuality. We then investigate the "real time" transformation of conceptual representations on a trial-to-trial basis. We show that it is possible to make strong predictions about the model's target task and behavior from trajectories alone. In addition, diverging points in single-trial trajectories correspond to the onset of rotation in aggregated-trial analysis. Finally, we show that both rotation and divergent trajectories occur in more naturalistic settings in which models are not overtly prompted to "lie" but rather report false statements in the course of completing a different task.
arxiv.titleZh: 运动中的表征：LLM 中的逐层旋转与轨迹分叉
arxiv.summaryZh: 静态单层激活读取不足以刻画模型行为，需转向层间表征演化。用真假陈述配合「说谎/诚实」提示，提取事实性方向并追踪其逐层旋转，再对照需要切换 3D 视角的任务与单次试验（trial）轨迹。结果显示，说谎与诚实条件下的方向随层逐渐分离，该旋转在视角切换任务中同样出现；仅凭单条轨迹即可较强预测模型的任务与行为，且单次试验轨迹的分叉点对应聚合分析中旋转的起始层。该现象在未显式要求说谎的自然任务中依然存在，说明旋转可能反映概念空间的一般性操作，可作为真实性分析与行为预测的信号。
arxiv.reason: 表征几何与真实性分析有新意，但偏离后训练/Agent 核心方向

arxiv.title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
arxiv.abstract: Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \$0.29 to \$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.
arxiv.comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices
arxiv.titleZh: Agent 执行 harness 的设计与跨域评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对智能体需协调规划、执行与审查才能完成复杂任务的问题，该执行 harness 将原始目标与可修订的计划、执行记录分离：planner 分配范围明确的任务，worker 产出结果与工件，reviewer 对照原始请求决定提交或要求追加工作，领域指令在构建期用任务输入与执行轨迹迭代而不依赖官方评分。Terminal-Bench 2.1 上 89 个实例通过 83 个（93.26%）；HealthBench Professional 525 任务的长度调整 rubric 分为 69.63，53 任务配对比较中聚合分比直接补全高 19.89 分，但任务级中位变化为 -1.46 分，单任务平均推理成本从 $0.29 升至 $2.13。结合延迟、指令修订记录与 reviewer 决策，可看清协调机制在何处提升完成率、何处引入回退及其代价。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 的系统性设计与多域评估，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Flattening Fantasies: Analyzing Stereotypes in Pornographic Discourse
arxiv.abstract: This study presents a large-scale quantitative analysis of 5.4 million video titles from xHamster, the world's fourth most visited pornography platform, to examine linguistic patterns used to describe different dimensions of identities (e.g., race and gender). Specifically, we investigate how nationalities, ethnic groups, and gender identities are portrayed in pornographic discourse, focusing on stereotypes and deviations from implicit norms of pornography. The results show the dominance of American pornography over other groups, which acts as the de facto norm for the adult industry. We identify persistent ethnic stereotypes reflecting colonial power dynamics, religious fetishization, and the sexualization of cultural taboos. The analysis reveals gendered representational differences across cultures, with a prevalent Madonna-Whore dichotomy in the portrayal of women and stereotypical depictions of men in physically dominant roles.
arxiv.titleZh: 扁平化的幻想：色情话语中的刻板印象分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对色情话语如何塑造身份刻板印象的问题，对全球访问量第四的色情平台xHamster的540万条视频标题做大规模量化语言分析，考察国籍、族裔与性别身份在描述维度上的用词模式。结果显示美国色情内容占据事实上的行业规范地位，其他群体被相对边缘化；族裔刻板印象持续存在，映射殖民权力结构、宗教恋物化与文化禁忌的性化。性别表征跨文化差异明显，女性普遍呈现圣母—娼妓二分，男性则被固化为体格支配角色。
arxiv.reason: 计算社会科学话语分析，与LLM方法及后训练方向无关

arxiv.title: Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT
arxiv.abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) gives large language model (LLM) agents access to physical observations, but one requested capability is usually offered by several devices, and the agent's plan does not say which one to call. Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments. In a simulated loading-dock workload, the proposed router achieves higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated device energy and latency, than nearest-device, advertised-quality, UCB1, and LinUCB selection.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习调用哪台设备：面向 IoT 中 LLM Agent 的在线工具接地
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM Agent 借助 IoT 获取物理观测时，同一项能力往往由多台设备提供，而 Agent 计划本身并不指明该调用哪一台；已有工作只做工具检索与计划可行性检查，不学习哪台合格设备能返回有用观测。该工作把已确定的工具调用绑定到具体物理端点，在服务成本与设备参与约束下用上下文 bandit 在线学习，并以自适应上下文划分加分层的端点树来复用执行反馈，用高斯奖励聚合保护个体反馈值。理论给出有限时域 regret 界与奖励统计的差分隐私保证；在模拟装卸场负载中，该方法相比最近设备、广告质量、UCB1 与 LinUCB 取得更高单步成功率与更优的成本调整服务，并降低模拟设备能耗与延迟。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用与 bandit 选择结合，但限于 IoT 仿真场景，分量有限

arxiv.title: FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.
arxiv.titleZh: FTFM：因子化表格基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 表格基础模型做上下文学习时面临两难：保留单元格级表示需要在行与列上反复做注意力，代价高昂；把每行压成固定嵌入虽快，却丢失细粒度状态。FTFM 为每一行、每一列各引入一个上下文潜变量，单元格不再两两直接注意力，而是通过所属行、列潜变量的交互完成更新，在保留特征级信息的同时减少重复注意力计算。在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等主流表格分类基准上取得有竞争力的预测性能。适用于表格数据的免训练上下文预测场景。
arxiv.reason: 表格基础模型，因子化注意力效率机制仅与LLM架构擦边

arxiv.title: Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions
arxiv.abstract: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.
arxiv.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. A first training on real documents is summarized; full results on real data in production are left to a companion paper
arxiv.titleZh: 窄决策模型：一种用于校准式类型化决策的 System-1 架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对组织内部高频、类型化的判断任务，用可自托管的小模型替代生成式 LLM，直接输出带校准概率的 Choice、Score、Noul 三类答案。方法把请求序列化为「状态→问题→选项」的前缀树，在带逻辑位置的块注意力掩码下运行双向编码器，使答案在构造上对选项顺序不变、且与其他问题相互独立；路由则通过组织架构图上的 Choice 复合与显式「以上皆非」选项实现。训练采用恰当评分规则配合课程学习，并给出校准、弃答、rubric 决策组合，以及在看留出数据前先验收机制的协议。公开与虚构数据上，不变性在训练后仍精确到舍入误差，小实例在未见过的组织架构图上路由显著优于词面检索，等算力下块架构损失低于成对 cross-encoder；真实法律文书上首版实例与线上 LLM 分类器的一致率为 91%。

arxiv.title: Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors
arxiv.abstract: Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.
arxiv.titleZh: 符号约束 Agent：挖掘形式化工具调用约束以防止 Agent 出错
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM Agent 工具调用中符号约束多依赖预定义安全策略、难以刻画复杂工具依赖的问题，提出 SCA 框架：从 API 文档中挖掘符号约束，并依据执行轨迹进行修正，再用 SMT 求解器在运行时校验工具调用；一旦出现违反约束的情况，就触发自然语言警告，或者在替换方案唯一时自动修复。在 AppWorld 上，约束修正将错误检测 F1 从 37.0 提升到 58.3（GPT-5.5 轨迹），从 39.3 提升到 61.9（Qwen3.5-27B 轨迹）；运行时修复在 40 次调用预算下使 GPT-5.4-mini 任务成功率提高 5.4 点，隐藏环境错误时提高 9.8 点，并减少 59–87% 的失败调用，迁移至 τ²-bench 最高提升 5.6 点。该工作说明自动获取的符号约束能提升工具调用的可靠性与任务完成率，适用于失败代价高或难以诊断的 Agent 场景。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用约束挖掘与运行时修复，方法新颖结果扎实

arxiv.title: Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing
arxiv.abstract: A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 编辑即语言：教LLM Agent原生上下文编辑的语法
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程推理与交互中上下文不断膨胀，而依赖外部harness生成工具调用代码的上下文编辑难以泛化。NCE框架把上下文编辑操作编码为专用特殊token构成的语法，使LLM Agent在原生生成过程中直接调用编辑；训练时迭代构造轨迹片段，让教师编辑以演化中的上下文为条件，将编辑变为原子化、内生的能力。在Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual与SWE-bench Pro上，NCE使LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的平均任务成功率分别提升5.6与4.5个百分点，平均token用量降低36%与15%。
arxiv.reason: Agent上下文编辑内化为原生能力，四项基准提升明显

arxiv.title: EmotiQ: A Quantum Residual Specialist Framework for Text Emotion Classification
arxiv.abstract: Emotion classification from text is challenging because many affective states are distinguished by subtle linguistic signals and semantically overlapping boundaries. We investigate whether compact quantum modules can serve as targeted residual specialists that assist traditional classifiers on difficult emotion decisions. We introduce EmotiQ, a residual specialist framework for text emotion classification using a frozen transformer classifier as the primary decision maker, identifies challenging emotion boundaries from validation behavior, and trains boundary specialists, including quantum encodings, data re-uploading specialists, prototype and fidelity specialists, and kernel-based specialists. Specialists are permitted to intervene only when they satisfy validation-based admission criteria. We evaluate the framework across six text emotion classification datasets and establish traditional model baselines. Experimental results show that the admitted EmotiQ policy improves mean macro-F1 metrics over the baseline, and achieves positive gains on five of six datasets. Among the quantum components, ZZ interaction feature maps are the most consistently effective, yielding a mean macro-F1 improvement of +0.0030 and positive gains on four datasets. These findings suggest that current quantum NLP methods can be deployed as residual specialists that provide localized improvements under strong classical supervision.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to IEEE ICTAI 2026
arxiv.titleZh: EmotiQ:一个用于文本情感分类的量子残差专家框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 文本情感分类中，许多情绪状态只靠细微语言信号区分，语义边界彼此重叠。EmotiQ 以一个冻结的 Transformer 分类器作为主决策器，先从验证集行为中定位困难的类别边界，再训练对应的边界专家(量子编码、数据重上传、原型与保真度、核方法等)，仅在通过验证集准入标准时允许其介入。在六个文本情感数据集上，被准入的策略平均 macro-F1 高于传统基线，并在六个数据集中的五个取得正增益;其中 ZZ 交互特征映射最为稳定，平均 macro-F1 提升 +0.0030，四个数据集为正增益。结果显示当前量子 NLP 方法可在强经典监督下作为残差专家提供局部改进。
arxiv.reason: 量子组件叠加情感分类，增益仅+0.003，偏离关注方向

arxiv.title: Beyond the record: evaluating probabilistic AI weather forecasts deep in the tail
arxiv.abstract: Can probabilistic artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasts retain skill beyond their training domain? We compare four state-of-the-art AI models (ArchesWeatherGen, U-Cast, WeatherNext2 and GenCast-mini) with the physics-based IFS-ENS over land in 2022, at 1.5° resolution and lead times of 2--10 days. Monthly ERA5 records from 1979--2021 define common historical boundaries, and we characterize new records set in 2022 by their depth, i.e., the exceedance margin relative to local historical variability. Two proper scores, record-threshold weighted CRPS and Brier score, assess the magnitude and probability of record exceedances across all eligible cases, retaining both missed extremes and false alarms. Verified against ERA5, AI models outperform IFS-ENS for heat and cold records at almost every lead and depth. For heat, the advantage strengthens with depth, partly because IFS-ENS over-forecasts deep records, and largely persists for deeper records under HRES-fc0 verification. For wind, gains erode for deeper records and longer leads. Better tail scores can nevertheless coexist with aggregate probability deficits or surpluses, and some improvements arise chiefly on non-exceedances. Increasing underprediction on progressively more extreme observed subsets can also arise through outcome selection, even for an ideal conditional-mean forecast. These findings establish that native probabilistic AI ensembles retain, and for heat increase, their advantage over IFS-ENS as thresholds move beyond local records, although all advantages narrow with lead time. They caution against generalizing the extrapolation failure reported for deterministic AI forecasts to probabilistic systems, and motivate common verification conventions that separate comparative tail skill, performance on realized extremes, and probabilistic calibration.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越历史记录:在分布尾部深处评估概率性 AI 天气预报
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察概率性 AI 天气预报在超出训练域的历史极值上是否仍保持技巧。以 1979–2021 年 ERA5 月度记录界定历史边界，用超出幅度刻画 2022 年新纪录的深度，并提出记录阈值加权 CRPS 与 Brier score 两项评分，在 1.5° 分辨率、2–10 天预报期上对比 ArchesWeatherGen、U-Cast、WeatherNext2、GenCast-mini 与物理模式 IFS-ENS。结果显示 AI 集合在冷暖纪录上几乎各预报期与各深度均优于 IFS-ENS，热纪录优势随深度增强，风纪录优势则随深度与预报期衰减;但尾部评分更优可与整体概率偏差共存，部分改进来自非超越事件。结论提示不应把确定性 AI 预报的外推失效直接推广到概率系统，并呼吁区分尾部比较技巧、实际极值表现与概率校准的验证规范。
arxiv.reason: 气象垂直领域的 AI 预报评估，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无关

arxiv.title: Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.
arxiv.titleZh: 在EPRI AI-ccelerating机组组合基准上的强化学习：诊断过度开机并用学习策略引导MILP
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对强化学习（RL）求解机组组合（UC）时独立智能体成本远高于MILP的问题，在EPRI的51机72小时基准上首次系统评估PPO与动作分支DQN，并探索用学习策略引导精确求解器。从头训练的策略开机台数约为纯火电MILP最优解的两倍、成本高39–64%，根源是独立采样决策的探索噪声让冗余机组充当保险；模仿MILP解并保守微调后，PPO与最优解差距缩至2.6%，惩罚成本最低（约5%）。固定微调策略的高置信决策可使MILP加速3.8–8.5倍，解质量损失仅0.10–0.25%。
arxiv.reason: 能源机组组合的RL应用，与LLM关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing
arxiv.abstract: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.
arxiv.comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
arxiv.titleZh: 审计 Agentic LLM 中的工具轨迹：来源定位与反事实依赖性检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 工具增强的 Agentic LLM 在生物预测任务上常显著超越无证据基线，但序列化的工具结果可能含数据集标识符、模板残留等隐藏标签捷径，制造出并无科学推理的虚假成功。为此提出两阶段审计：PT2D（Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition）把标签预测性信号归因到单个工具结果，避免拼接轨迹中的信号稀释；Token-Class Redaction 再对定位出的捷径做反事实删改，检验冻结模型是否真的依赖它。在 TCR-pMHC 结合预测上，最强信号被定位到某一工具结果中的标识符，删去后性能跌至随机水平，推翻了「模型已学会使用科学证据」的表面结论。该流程可用于工具增强 Agent 的基准可靠性审查。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具轨迹的捷径审计，命中评测可靠性方向

arxiv.title: From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing
arxiv.abstract: Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays. This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions. Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026, Applied Data Science Track
arxiv.titleZh: 从临床风险预测到运营决策：面向ICU人员配置的不确定性感知框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床风险模型多止步于区分度指标，如何把概率化风险估计转成受排班刚性、招聘延迟约束的运营决策仍缺系统方法。该框架不改动上游预测模型，显式建模动态预测不确定性，用条件风险价值（CVaR）度量极端人力短缺暴露，将风险校准后的聚合需求信号嵌入逐小时滚动时域排班策略，生成带延迟约束的人员配置决策。在MIMIC-IV真实轨迹上，其成本—短缺权衡优于确定性与纯反应式基线，Pareto前沿分析显示不确定性感知的需求构造会改变不同安全偏好下的资源分配，校准漂移压力测试下仍保持稳健。
arxiv.reason: 以ICU排班为落点，属医疗垂直应用，仅擦边LLM方向

arxiv.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.
arxiv.titleZh: StopLoss：教智能体预测失败并提前停止
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对编码智能体在注定无法通过验证的运行上持续消耗算力、而用前沿模型充当监工本身又成本高昂的问题，提出小型外部监视器 StopLoss：用已完成轨迹及其验证器结果作监督，把最终结果回标到更早的局部窗口，微调语言模型以单次前向给最近工具调用步骤打分，并用成功运行上校准的阈值转成中止决策，且无需改动执行器。在 SWE-rebench 的 GPT 系轨迹上训练，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Pro 子集上用 GPT、Claude 执行器评测，首次检查就可将失败预测从接近随机提升到有用信号，单次检查成本比测试的通用评判器低一至两个数量级。相对跑完全部任务，Verified 上保留 99% 成功运行的同时将“每次保留解”成本降低 4.5%，Pro 子集最高降 31%，Qwen3-8B 骨干下达 48%，四种设置下均优于所有评判器策略，说明廉价失败识别可让早停自身收回成本。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体早停与失败预测，属 Agent 与效率方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation
arxiv.abstract: Time series are ubiquitous across different domains, and the growing use of synthetic data for privacy-preserving sharing, data augmentation, and stress testing makes time series generation increasingly important. Early generative approaches are predominantly autoregressive, which can suffer from low sample diversity, error accumulation, and difficulty modeling long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce FracTS, a hierarchical, coarse-to-fine autoregressive model for multivariate time series generation. Inspired by fractal generative modeling developed for images, FracTS adapts the paradigm from 2D to 1D sequences by learning a multi-scale representation that captures global trajectory structure at coarse scales and local dynamics at fine scales while following the autoregressive nature of time series. In contrast to unstructured images, time series are structured, allowing easy automated or designated temporal feature processing optimized for the model, and global (static) feature extraction describing the instances that generate the corresponding time series in the collection. We incorporate them in the generation process to further improve the generation quality. The design naturally handles multivariate dependencies and improves long-horizon temporal coherence without requiring fixed-length inputs. Experiments on five datasets (two conditional, three unconditional) conducted against seven baselines show that FracTS consistently outperforms baselines across marginal distribution and predictive ML utility, and correlation preservation in the unconditional setting. In particular, the predictive ML utility is averagely improved by 100.0% and 75.0-81.0% for unconditional and conditional time series datasets compared to the best baseline (relative error computed on dataset-averaged raw values). Code is available at: https://github.com/BetterdataLabs/fracts.
arxiv.titleZh: FracTS：分层自回归的时间序列生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对早期自回归生成模型样本多样性低、误差累积、难以建模长程依赖的问题，提出分层、由粗到细的自回归多变量时间序列生成模型。借鉴图像分形生成建模，将二维范式迁移到一维序列，学习多尺度表示：粗尺度刻画全局轨迹结构，细尺度刻画局部动态，并引入面向时间序列的自动/指定时序特征处理与描述实例的全局静态特征以提升生成质量。设计天然处理多变量依赖，无需固定长度输入即可改善长程时序连贯性。在五个数据集（两个条件、三个无条件）对七个基线，边际分布与预测性 ML 效用均稳定领先，无条件与条件设置下预测性 ML 效用相对最佳基线平均提升 100.0% 与 75.0–81.0%。
arxiv.reason: 时间序列生成，与 LLM/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice
arxiv.abstract: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

arxiv.titleZh: 当共情偏离目标：LLM建议中目标置换的基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 对话模型常以温暖安慰替代实质帮助，该工作将这一失败模式定义为「目标置换」（goal displacement），并构建GDB基准：230个场景覆盖九个领域、18个模型的4134条人工评分回答。方法上用「硬约束×情绪困扰」的2×2分类区分无法直面不可行目标、共情与实用指导结合失败，以及反向置换（用未被请求的问题解决替代所需情感支持），并用删除测试评分规则检验剔除纯支持性句子后是否仍有实质帮助。结果显示陷阱型置换率在0.0%–37.7%之间，与Chatbot Arena Elo强负相关（ρ=-0.706，n=15），反向置换最高达41.9%；高复杂低压力条件下谄媚率35.0%但置换率仅7.5%，两者关联微弱；匹配的OLMo-2检查点显示混合置换在SFT后仍为52.3%，经DPO降至13.8%。该基准可用于模型比较、后训练评估与回归测试。

arxiv.title: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

arxiv.titleZh: ATEST：面向LLM推理的自适应资源感知测试时缩放
arxiv.summaryZh: 固定采样预算的测试时缩放既忽略问题难度，也无视GPU争用下推理能耗的变化;实测同一四样本查询在高负载下能耗最高升至4.1倍。ATEST在线模式无需离线标定，边采样边估计多数答案的稳定性、监控GPU实时状态并在线学习单步能耗，据此决定何时停止;离线校准模式则用准确率与成本模型为每个查询选取预算。在A100上用Phi-3-mini评测四个推理与问答数据集，在线模式在不超过能耗预算的前提下取得最高或统计持平的准确率，并在高负载GSM8K上以60.0%准确率、零延后优于校准模式的44.0%与42.4%延后;含离线剖析，在线模式GPU时间与能耗分别省42倍与48倍。适用于负载波动环境下的推理服务成本控制。

arxiv.title: Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows
arxiv.abstract: Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.
arxiv.titleZh: Bud ContextCompact 2.0：让小语言模型和受限上下文窗口下的 Agent 兼具成功率与准确率的上下文压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮 Agent 会话会超出上下文窗口，小模型与受限推理系统尤甚。Bud ContextCompact 2.0 用摘要替换较早轮次并考察触发时机：在基于录制会话的召回题上，压缩到 16K 使 1.2B 模型准确率从截断的 0.247、完整 32K 历史的 0.176 升至 0.335（p<0.001），9B 模型由 0.515 升至 0.577。在 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上，长会话解决率从 41% 升至 53%，短会话不变，每个已解决任务少用 13% token。摘要中位耗时 161 秒，45 分钟预算下增益消失；未压缩时的主要失败是推理轮次被历史挤占空间，而非历史溢出。

arxiv.title: Dynamics-Aligned Representation Learning under Induced Partial Observability
arxiv.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has enabled sample-efficient learning of continuous control policies from high-dimensional observations through learned latent dynamics models. These models are typically trained with observation reconstruction objectives, which provide strong supervision but can bias representations toward visual fidelity leading to an undertrained prior and unreliable long-horizon predictions. We propose a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training by sampling a spatial binary mask from a Beta--Bernoulli random field and applying it to the raw observation. The gate probability is resampled at each time step, exposing the encoder to conditions ranging from near-total occlusion to near-full visibility. Integration of our method requires minimal architectural changes from existing dynamics models: the gated observation and the binary mask are channel-wise concatenated and passed to the encoder as a single augmented input, with no modifications to the broader training pipeline. We evaluate the proposed approach on a set of pixel-based continuous control tasks selected from the DeepMind Control Suite. Using model predictive control for evaluation, which relies solely on open-loop model rollouts, we show that stochastic gating improves planning performance and data efficiency across tasks. Further analysis demonstrates that performance is robust to the spatial scale of the mask, and a balanced observability during training outperforms configurations biased toward either sparser or denser observations.
arxiv.titleZh: 诱导部分可观测性下的动力学对齐表征学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于模型的强化学习通常以观测重建为目标训练隐动力学模型，容易让表征偏向视觉保真度，从而削弱先验训练并损害长程预测。该方法在训练时从Beta–Bernoulli随机场采样空间二值掩码作用于原始观测，构成随机门控，使编码器在近乎全遮挡到近乎全可见之间变化；实现上仅需将门控观测与掩码按通道拼接后送入编码器，无需改动训练流程。在DeepMind Control Suite的像素级连续控制任务上，以仅依赖开环模型推演的模型预测控制评估，随机门控提升了规划性能与数据效率；性能对掩码空间尺度稳健，且训练时观测可见度均衡优于过稀疏或过密集的配置。

arxiv.title: KPI-Aware Multimodal Anomaly Detection for 5G and Open RAN Telemetry
arxiv.abstract: Reliable anomaly detection is a deployment bottleneck for 5G/Open RAN observability and emerging self-optimizing 6G systems, where hundreds of heterogeneous KPIs, severe class imbalance, and strict alert budgets make purely numerical scores brittle. We present KAC, a deployment-oriented KPI-aware multimodal anomaly-detection framework that uses KPI-level residual-text alignment to turn compact operator-style summaries into a learnable feedback signal over full-KPI temporal evidence. This gives the detector broad numerical coverage like modern time-series models, while retaining the sparse KPI-specific reasoning that makes operator feedback sustainable in a future operator-facing workflow. Across public telecom telemetry, enterprise-scale Open RAN observability data, and a Nokia benchmark built from real 5G RAN production packet traces with realism-hardened injected anomalies, KAC achieves strong threshold-based detection performance while remaining competitive on threshold-free ranking metrics. On TelecomTS, at a fixed 2.5 percent false-positive-rate operating point, KAC achieves the highest recall among the evaluated residual-based methods while maintaining comparable precision; across the evaluated benchmarks, it remains robust under substantial class imbalance. KAC is integrated in pre-production shadow mode with Nokia's GKE-based KPI construction pipeline, where it continuously scores telemetry windows alongside an internal packet-level anomaly detector for operational evaluation.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the IEEE ICDM 2026 Applied Research Track
arxiv.titleZh: 面向5G与Open RAN遥测的KPI感知多模态异常检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对5G/Open RAN可观测性中KPI数量多、类别极不均衡、告警预算受限导致纯数值异常分数不稳定的问题，提出部署导向的KPI感知多模态框架KAC:以KPI级残差—文本对齐，把精简的运维风格摘要转化为可学习反馈信号，叠加在全KPI时序证据之上，兼顾数值覆盖广度与稀疏的KPI级推理。在TelecomTS固定2.5%假阳性率下取得所评估残差类方法中最高召回且精度相当，并在Open RAN企业级数据与Nokia基于真实5G RAN生产抓包构建的基准上保持稳健。系统已以预生产影子模式接入Nokia的GKE KPI流水线运行评估。

arxiv.title: Where Are Language-Specific Features Represented in Multilingual LLMs? Everywhere
arxiv.abstract: Previous work has argued that multilingual LLMs encode language-specific features most strongly in their initial and final layers, implying that intermediate layers support language-agnostic representations. This paper reconsiders this finding by performing four different experiments: three that undertake a fine-grained analysis of representations of Portuguese and Spanish, two closely related languages, and one large-scale language identification experiment that covers over 200 languages. The results of these experiments challenge the strict separation between language-specific and language-agnostic layers in multilingual LLMs, using Llama 3.2 1B as a test case. By analyzing and manipulating contextual sentence embeddings, we demonstrate that language identity remains strongly recoverable throughout the model rather than being restricted to initial and final layers. Moreover, we find that the model tends to classify ambiguous strings as closer to Spanish than to Portuguese, revealing a skew in model behavior that differs from human judgments.
arxiv.titleZh: 多语言 LLM 中的语言特异性特征在哪里被表征？无处不在
arxiv.summaryZh: 重新检验「语言特异性特征集中于首尾层、中间层为语言无关表征」的既有结论。以 Llama 3.2 1B 为对象做四组实验：三组细粒度分析葡萄牙语与西班牙语这两个近缘语言的表征，一组覆盖 200+ 种语言的大规模语言识别。通过分析与操纵上下文句向量，发现语言身份在模型各层均可强恢复，而非局限于首尾层；同时模型倾向把歧义字符串判为更接近西班牙语，与人类判断存在系统性偏差。这为多语言模型的分层表征假设提供了反例，提示语言识别与表征干预不应只关注首尾层。
arxiv.reason: 多语言 LLM 分层表征分析，属机理性研究，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Steered Not Stirred: Effective Reward Tilting using Surrogate Reward Mixing
arxiv.abstract: Continuous-time generative models, from diffusion models, flow matching, and now flow maps, owe their practical value to high-fidelity generation and steerability. In many applications, a ground-truth latent ``oracle'' reward $R^*$ is unavailable or expensive to evaluate, e.g., human judgments or experimental measurements. Although the oracle reward is not directly observable, it can often be approximated through multiple cheaper surrogates that, individually, provide incomplete characterizations but collectively reveal substantial information about the downstream task. In this paper, we present a method for composing such surrogates to steer a pretrained model toward the distribution tilted by an unavailable $R^*$. Given a small feedback set of oracle rankings or numerical rewards, we introduce Mixing And Reward Tilting for INference-time Improvement (MARTINI), which learns a surrogate composition for plug-and-play use with standard inference-time steering methods. Our theory characterizes surrogate information limits and relates population recovery error to ideal-target KL at small tilt strength. For preferences, the bound additionally accounts for an irreducible mismatch between the Plackett-Luce population target and the conditional mean. Experiments demonstrate improved oracle-tilt fidelity in language generation and ImageNet alignment, and improved joint pose accuracy and validity in protein-ligand cofolding, without inference-time oracle queries.
arxiv.titleZh: 引导而非搅动：用代理奖励混合实现有效的奖励倾斜
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散模型、flow matching 与 flow map 等连续时间生成模型依赖奖励引导，但真实oracle奖励（人类判断、实验测量）常不可得或代价高昂，只能借助多个各自不完整的廉价代理奖励。MARTINI用少量oracle排序或数值反馈学习代理奖励的混合方式，再与标准推理时引导方法即插即用组合，逼近由不可见R*倾斜的分布。理论刻画代理信息的上限，并在小倾斜强度下把总体恢复误差与理想目标的KL关联，同时计入Plackett-Luce目标与条件均值之间的固有偏差。语言生成与ImageNet对齐实验提升了oracle倾斜保真度，蛋白-配体共折叠提升了位姿精度与有效性，推理时无需查询oracle。
arxiv.reason: 核心是扩散与流匹配生成模型的引导，属低分方向，仅与奖励对齐擦边

arxiv.title: Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI
arxiv.abstract: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.
